subject.title: fix(line): AI-assisted - requireMention can now optionally gate non-text messages with bounded pending-media retention

question: Should LINE adopt `requireMentionForNonText` and `pendingMediaLimit` as a supported delayed-delivery contract after the coupled history/media race is fixed and proven live?
rationale: The proposal adds persistent configuration and intentionally associates media from an earlier message with a later turn; implementation correctness alone cannot establish that product contract.

options.title: Approve race-safe delayed delivery
options.body: Keep both opt-in settings, fix coupled state serialization, and require live proof before merge.

options.title: Approve gating only
options.body: Support non-text mention gating but remove pending-media retention and cross-message association.

options.title: Decline the new contract
options.body: Preserve current non-text passthrough behavior and close the paired feature direction.

recommendation.title: Approve race-safe delayed delivery
recommendation.body: Keep both opt-in settings, fix coupled state serialization, and require live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current LINE mention-gating and pending-history behavior that defines the closest existing contract.
